title: `Callable` doesn't keep the `RefCounted` alive during the call by itself
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible: master

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (457470a8d) - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 28 Jul 2026 13:49:51 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) UHD Graphics 630 (CFL GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9300H CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

While comparing the modified code from https://redirect.github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/117850#issuecomment-4136806530 with a native copy of it to test how the engine manages the lifetimes I found this difference in behaviour.

<details>
<summary>Working</summary>

Works correctly the the `RefCounted` that was in `to_remove` was alive until the call to `test_kept_alive` ended.
```gdscript
class_name Outer extends Node

class Inner extends RefCounted:
    var self_holder: Outer
    var some_state := 0

    func test_kept_alive():
        self_holder.to_remove = null
        some_state += 1

var to_remove: Inner

func _ready() -> void:
    to_remove = Inner.new()
    to_remove.self_holder = self
    var callable = to_remove.test_kept_alive
    callable.call()
```
</details>
<details>
<summary>Not working</summary>

The `RefCounted` is removed and freed immediately.
```c++
class _KeepaliveInnerRef;
class _KeepaliveOuterRefHolder : public Object {
	GDCLASS(_KeepaliveOuterRefHolder, Object);
public:
	Ref<_KeepaliveInnerRef> to_remove = nullptr;
};

class _KeepaliveInnerRef : public RefCounted {
	GDCLASS(_KeepaliveInnerRef, RefCounted);
protected:
	void _notification(int p_what) {
		if (p_what == NOTIFICATION_PREDELETE) {
			is_deleted = true;
		}
	}
public:
	int remove_self_and_get_count() {
		self_holder->to_remove = Ref<_KeepaliveInnerRef>();
		some_state++;
		return get_reference_count();
	}
	inline static bool is_deleted = false;
	_KeepaliveOuterRefHolder *self_holder = nullptr;
	int some_state = 0;
};

TEST_CASE("[Object] Keep RefCounted alive during Callable call") {
	_KeepaliveOuterRefHolder *outer = memnew(_KeepaliveOuterRefHolder);
	outer->to_remove.instantiate();
	outer->to_remove->self_holder = outer;

	Callable callable = callable_mp(outer->to_remove.ptr(), &_KeepaliveInnerRef::remove_self_and_get_count);
	const int count_at_the_end = callable.call();

	CHECK_EQ(count_at_the_end, 1);
	CHECK_MESSAGE(
			_KeepaliveInnerRef::is_deleted,
			"RefCounted was deleted.");
	memdelete(outer);
}
```
</details>

The native direct call also doesn't keep it alive, but there is nothing we can really do about that, as C++ doesn't make any promises about the object outliving its method call (see working `delete this;`, you are just forbidden from accessing the object after it).

Currently GDScript behaves as if `Callable` keeps the `RefCounted` during the function call alive, but if we rewrote `class Inner extends RefCounted` into a native class while keeping the `Outer` as GDScript we will run into `heap-use-after-free` as `Callable` doesn't actually keep it alive.

Also this is not https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/74990 , this issue is about the `RefCounted` not being kept alive only during calling the stored method.

Edit: The issue was reproduced with GDExtension:
While similar to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/122367 and looking the same, the root cause is different. And if this is to change from the GDScript side it will involve really invasively inspecting the variables for possible callables and fetching the refcounted object inside it. Which doesn't sound too good.

### Steps to reproduce

See not working code.
Build command: 
```
scons target=editor optimize=none accesskit=no use_llvm=yes linker=lld debug_symbols=yes tests=yes dev_build=yes use_asan=yes dev_mode=yes
```
Test:
```
./bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.dev.x86_64.llvm.san --test -tc="*Keep RefCounted alive*"
```

Edit: Reproduced with GDExtension
<details>
<summary>Code</summary>

<details>
<summary>C++</summary>

```c++
class InnerGDExt : public RefCounted {
	GDCLASS(InnerGDExt, RefCounted)

private:
	Node *outer = nullptr;
	int some_state = 0;

protected:
	static void _bind_methods() {
		ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("test_kept_alive"), &InnerGDExt::test_kept_alive);
		ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_state"), &InnerGDExt::get_state);
		ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("set_state", "state"), &InnerGDExt::set_state);
		ClassDB::bind_method(D_METHOD("get_temp", "outer"), &InnerGDExt::get_temp);

		ADD_PROPERTY(PropertyInfo(Variant::INT, "state"), "set_state", "get_state");
	}

public:
	InnerGDExt() {}
	~InnerGDExt() {}
	int test_kept_alive() {
		outer->set("to_remove", nullptr);
		some_state++;
		return get_reference_count();
	}

	int get_state() {
		if (outer) {
			outer->set("to_remove", nullptr);
		}
		some_state++;
		return some_state;
	}
	void set_state(int p_state) {
		if (outer) {
			outer->set("to_remove", nullptr);
		}
		some_state = p_state;
	}
	Ref<InnerGDExt> get_temp(Node *p_outer) {
		outer = p_outer;
		return Ref<InnerGDExt>(this);
	}
};
```
</details>
